title: StableBar scene
description: One screen that StableBar --render-scenes draws offscreen. A scene runs nothing: its outputs, history and workspaces replace every command, provider and window manager.

configuration.description: A StableBar configuration, or the path of one relative to this file.

packages.description: Package folders, relative to this file, installed as --install-package installs them. Packages are read from beside the configuration, so a scene with packages gives its configuration inline, and it's written to the scene's work folder. With barLink or shareLink, they're installed from the Store, and with barLink the Store lists them.

packageOrigins.description: Why packages, by their path in packages, were installed from no source, as Settings and the Store show it: saved with Save as Theme, from a theme link, or the look of a bar link. The others came from a folder.

outputs.description: Script outputs by widget id or provider name: an object as a script prints it, or plain text. A provider no widget shows, such as the microphone or nowPlaying behind the Sound details, takes the output under its name.

history.description: Graph samples by widget id or provider name.

mixer.description: The Sound details' mixer, as on a Mac where these regular apps talk to CoreAudio, with System Audio Recording allowed.

apps.description: The apps, each with its own volume, mute and output device UID when it has one, and whether it plays now.

outputs.description: The output devices, the first being the default.

desktopShortcuts.description: Switch to Desktop shortcuts enabled on the stand-in Mac, for setup and Settings. All off by default; workspaces supplies the desktops that exist.

yabaiSpaces.description: yabai's query --spaces objects, drawn in place of workspaces, every space on display 1.

yabaiApps.description: The bundle identifier of each yabai window's pid, which StableBar otherwise reads from the running apps.

dockBadges.description: Dock badge labels by bundle identifier, for a Workspaces widget that shows badges.

focusedWindow.description: The window-id of the window the window manager reports as focused.

activeApp.description: The active app's bundle identifier. Finder by default.

menu.description: The menu a popup scene shows in place of the widget's popup, as an app menu widget opens one: its items, with the values Accessibility gives a menu item.

title.description: The item's title. An empty title is a separator.

virtualKey.description: AXMenuItemCmdVirtualKey: the virtual key code of a key without a character.

glyph.description: AXMenuItemCmdGlyph: the menu glyph of a key without a character.

modifiers.description: AXMenuItemCmdModifiers: 0 is ⌘ alone, then 1 adds ⇧, 2 ⌥, 4 ⌃, 8 removes ⌘ and 16 adds fn. 0 by default.

enabled.description: Whether the item can be chosen. True by default.

checked.description: Whether the item has a checkmark.

submenu.description: Whether the item opens a submenu.

draw.description: What to draw. `update` draws the update popup for a sample offer, with the request for a star on GitHub. `setup` draws a step of setup's tour, 1512 by 982 points by default, with the bar above it as the configuration has it: setup's choices show in the tour, not on the bar, since previewing them would start the commands of the widgets they add. `accessibilityGuide` draws the panel that asks people to drag StableBar into the Accessibility list in System Settings. `share` draws Share My Bar for a 1512 by 982 point screen with the setup tour's wallpaper, at Bar only, and `shareLink` the same with What it shares open. `barLinkReview` draws the Store's review of the packages that barLink's ticked widgets need, as Use this bar opens it.

widget.description: The widget whose popup or Settings page to draw. With `bar`, the bar is drawn with that widget's popup open, below the bar or above a bar at the bottom, or, for a widget without a popup that has hover controls, those controls in their tooltip.

group.description: For `settings`, without `widget`: the group whose page Settings → Bar draws, with its widgets listed under it.

view.description: For `popup`: the view of the widget's popup to draw in place of its layout, under its back arrow.

section.description: The Settings section to draw when no widget is named. `help` opens the first answer of its Questions; `feedback` draws Send feedback in Help, with a sample bug, bug report, GitHub account and coding agent; `crashes` draws Crashes in Status, with sample crash reports of a release, of a development build and of a launch that dyld stopped, which Crashes leaves out.

package.description: With section packages, the installed package whose settings to draw.

themeLink.description: A theme folder relative to this file, opened as a link on Settings Theme. Requires draw settings and section theme, without a widget.

barLink.description: A bar link's JSON payload relative to this file, opened as a link on Settings Theme. Requires draw settings and section theme, without a widget, or draw barLinkReview.

untickedWidgets.description: With barLink, the IDs of the link's widgets that its card shows unticked.

tab.description: The tab of the widget's Settings page: content, style or behavior. With section bar and no widget, the tab of the bar's settings: look or placement.

uninstall.description: What the Uninstall sheet shows for a sample Mac: its confirmation, or the steps that failed before StableBar quits. The confirmation by default.

starRequest.description: For `update`, the popup's star request, and for Help in `settings`, Star on GitHub in the sidebar: opening the repository, starring through a signed-in GitHub CLI, or thanking for the star, which Help shows as Starred on GitHub. Opening the repository by default.

setup.description: For `setup`: the step to draw, the choices made before it, and what setup reads from the Mac, pinned so the drawing doesn't depend on the Mac that draws it. Every key is optional.

workspaceCheck.description: A canned result for Finishing touches when the configuration has yabai or OmniWM Workspaces. Never contacts a window manager; defaults to signalsMissing for yabai and ipcOff for OmniWM.

step.description: The step of the tour: where the bar goes, its look, the finishing touches, the permissions, or Try your bar. placement by default.

placement.description: The first step's choice, made before drawing: Replace the menu bar (top), Keep the menu bar (belowMenuBar) or Put it at the bottom (bottom). Without it, none is picked.

preset.description: The preset picked on the second step.

menuBarHides.description: Whether macOS hides its menu bar automatically. false by default.

accessibility.description: Whether macOS allows StableBar Accessibility. true by default.

automation.description: Whether macOS lets StableBar control System Events, which hiding or showing the menu bar needs. true by default.

calendars.description: Whether macOS allows StableBar full Calendar access. true by default.

battery.description: Whether the Mac has an internal battery, which presets add Battery for. true by default.

notch.description: Whether any connected display has a notch, which the Notch preset needs. true by default.

inApplications.description: Whether StableBar runs from an Applications folder, which Open at login needs. true by default.

suggested.description: Store index entries the look step shows under Found on your Mac, as if the Mac had their tools. None by default; the Store's index is never downloaded.

applicationMove.description: Draw the Move to Applications row in setup or Settings General without touching any app: its button, confirmation, existing copy, failure, progress, or direction back to an open setup. A setup scene also needs setup.inApplications false.

windowsUnderBar.description: Draw setup's last step or Settings General as if this window manager ran and left a window under the bar, with the warning and the gap it needs for the scene's bar. Drawing never reads this Mac's windows.

shareScreen.description: For `share` and `shareLink`: the screen Share My Bar draws the bar on. `this` is the scene's 1512 by 982 point screen without a notch, and `air13`, `pro14` and `pro16` a 13-inch MacBook Air, 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro at their default sizes, with the notch. this by default.

sharePreset.description: For `share` and `shareLink`: the shape of the image Share My Bar draws. `bar` is the bar alone on a strip of wallpaper, and `landscape`, `square` and `portrait` are 16:9, 1:1 and 4:5. bar by default.

macOSMajorVersion.description: The macOS major version for feature availability in setup and Settings. 26 by default, independently of the Mac that draws.

appearances.description: The appearances to draw, each to its own image. Both by default.

accessibilityDisplay.description: For `bar` and `popup`: the settings of System Settings → Accessibility → Display to draw with. The others are off, whatever the Mac that draws has. macOS turns on Reduce transparency with Increase contrast, so list both to draw what a Mac with Increase contrast shows.
